title: Columbia Gorge Half Day Tour 3 Waterfalls and Vista House
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the Columbia River Gorge on a 4-hour shared small-group tour from Portland. Visit five waterfalls, including Latourell, Wahkeena and Oregon's 620-foot Multnomah Falls. Take in panoramic views from Vista House at Crown Point, relax at Rooster Rock State Park and optionally visit The Grotto. Door-to-door transportation and an English-speaking driver-guide are included, with Mandarin Chinese available on request. This shared tour is limited to six guests, and other travelers may join your departure. Adults and children are charged per person. Infants ages 0-2 travel free but must be included in the booking and occupy their own seat. Complimentary age-appropriate child safety seats are available on request; provide each child's age, height and weight when booking. This tour is not wheelchair accessible. Walking paths and stairs at some viewpoints require a moderate fitness level.
